headings: H3: What is the A2A Protocol
H3: Open Source SDKs and Tooling

clean_room_contracts_extracted.a2a_protocol_definition_CORTI_VERBATIM: The Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is an open standard that enables secure, framework-agnostic communication between autonomous AI agents.
why_corti_uses_a2a_verbatim: Supports real workflows (discovery, task negotiation, streaming updates)
Preserves security and opacity (structured messages without sharing internal memory/tools)

icoder_mapping.current_state: iCoDer has A2A v0.3 wrapper at /a2a (Phase 5 Track C, /api/v1/coding-compliance/a2a) and ICODER_V1_A2A_SPEC.md
icoder_mapping.implication: iCoDer A2A implementation is independent of Corti; both iCoDer and Corti build on the SAME public spec. This is clean-room by construction.

clean_room_contracts_extracted.schema_note: Page does NOT republish the A2A schema. Schema is at a2a-protocol.org. iCoDer Charter §6 Task state machine (submitted/working/input_required/completed/failed/canceled) and Charter §13.1 Memory source-IDs spec are derived from the A2A public spec, NOT from Corti.
